properties.notes: Full: Major: Conversion of mill building to 14 one and two bed flats on three floors with garages at ground floor and parking accessed off Kelbrook Road.. This is a mill building which is currently occupied by a number of businesses. A planning permission was previously granted at the site for conversion. However the permission has now expired. There have been some pre-application interest from the owner/developer about bringing the site forward.
